name: Uno guard
description: Uno's guardrails: whom it texts and emails, approvals, purchases, and per-agent scoping.

adminAgentId.description: The owner's agent: exempt from scoping, and the only one that asks the owner's approval directly. Unset: no admin.

ownerName.description: The owner's name in the setup note. Unset: "the owner".

fallbackAgentId.description: Agent that catches senders with no binding of their own. Its turns end silently before the model runs. Unset: none.

testSinkHandle.description: A fictional number (e.g. +15555550142) whose messages are logged and never sent, for tests. Texting it is always allowed. Unset: none.

mailAddresses.description: Agent id -> that person's email addresses. Agents other than the admin's see only mail from these addresses, and sending to them needs no approval. Unset: no mail for them.

sharedSites.description: Sites whose logins everyone shares (e.g. amazon.com). They live only in the family browser profile; the admin's agent opens them there. Default none.

purchases.description: Purchases, as the model declares them with the purchase_check tool: "off" says no (carts, returns and browsing still work); "approve" asks the owner for a 👍 first; "limit" lets a purchase at or under purchaseLimit through and asks the owner over it or with no total. Other agents can ask only when approvals.plugin forwards to the owner's chat; otherwise they're told no. Default off.

purchaseLimit.description: Dollars: with purchases "limit", orders at or under this go through without the owner's 👍. Default 25.

approvalAgents.description: Agents besides the admin's that may ask the owner for 👍 on texts, email and invites outside the family (e.g. the family group chat's). Works only when approvals.plugin forwards to the owner's chat (mode targets or both); otherwise they're blocked. Default none.

familySpaces.description: The family's shared spaces by name: a Reminders list, calendar, Notes folder and iCloud Drive folder in Uno's iCloud. Every agent that can use one is told about it. Default none.

spaces.description: Agent id -> that person's own spaces (same keys as familySpaces). Their agent is told about each: in use once unlocked for their agent, otherwise an invite waiting on their Accept. Default none.

logDir.description: Folder for shell-commands.jsonl and media-owners.json. Default ~/.openclaw/uno-data.

purchaseFreeSites.description: Sites where purchases never need the owner's approval (standing subscriptions, for example), when purchases isn't off.

builderBinary.description: The builder's own command name (the coding agent the builder script runs); running it any way but the builder script is blocked.

schedulingAgents.description: Agents besides the admin's that may schedule one-time texts and check-ins back to their own chat (the family group chat).
